# Synthetic hotspot regression fixture

`synthetic-pack.zip` is the exact authored fixture used for the 2026-10-18 workflow audit. It contains fictional lab terms/questions, an original programmatically drawn blue circle/orange square PNG, and circle/polygon targets. It contains no real quizzes, profiles, history, backups or credentials. Source text and diagram: original synthetic DLMS test material, CC0-1.0 as declared inside the pack. Code/tests remain under the repository MIT license.

Retain the ZIP bytes unchanged so browser-based DLMS and all Desktop hosts can reproduce the same new/imported content paths. Tests use the ordinary validated pack generator; they never read an owner profile or repair old quizzes. SHA-256 is recorded in the repair report's file inventory.
